notes: Low-credit alerts: Settings → Notifications adds a Low balance alert toggle with 5/10/20 USD thresholds; usage is refreshed on launch when enabled, and a once-per-day usage-alerts notification deep-links to Usage when the remaining balance drops below the threshold (quiet hours respected).
